declarations.docstring: Exhibits the natural identification between the two Hom-valued functors associated with subgroup restriction and coinduction.
Packages restriction from an ambient group to a subgroup as the left adjoint of coinduction.
The restriction-coinduction Hom equivalence sends a morphism to its value at the identity element.
Identifies maps into a coinduced representation with maps out of the corresponding restricted representation.
The component of the Hom-functor isomorphism at a representation agrees with the associated Hom-valued isomorphism.
On a subgroup representation, the Hom-functor isomorphism acts through the inverse restriction-coinduction equivalence.
A restriction-coinduction correspondence exists between the displayed spaces of representation morphisms.
Gives the Hom-valued isomorphism for a fixed representation of the ambient group.
The Hom-valued isomorphism sends each map by the inverse restriction-coinduction correspondence.
Forms the Hom-valued functor using maps into the coinduction of a subgroup representation.
Evaluating the coinduction Hom functor yields the module of maps into the coinduced representation.
Forms the Hom-valued functor using maps from the restriction of an ambient representation.
Evaluating the restriction Hom functor yields the module of maps from the restricted representation.
Coinduces representations from a subgroup to its ambient group.
Restricts representations of an ambient group to a subgroup.
